user.title: Duquesne Light collector
user.description: The collector fetches your Duquesne Light usage and bills once a day (it needs a headless browser, so it runs as an add-on or container) and serves them on your network. Point this at its API.

data_description.url: The add-on listens on port 8765: http://localhost:8765 on Home Assistant OS, or http://<host>:8765 for a Docker Compose collector elsewhere.
data_description.api_token: Only if you set api_token on the add-on (COLLECTOR_API_TOKEN for Compose).

reconfigure.title: Duquesne Light collector
reconfigure.description: Change where the collector is or its token. Usage history carries on.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the collector at that URL.
error.not_collector: Something answered at that URL, but it isn't a Duquesne collector.

abort.already_configured: This collector is already set up.

collector_stale.title: Duquesne collector hasn't fetched since {last_success}
collector_stale.description:
The collector at {url} normally fetches usage and bills every day, but its last successful run was {last_success}. Last error: {error}.

Check the add-on (or container) log. If Duquesne Light changed its site, the collector may need an update.

collector_auth.title: Duquesne collector can't log in to Duquesne Light
collector_auth.description:
The collector at {url} reports: {message}.

Fix the username and password in the add-on's configuration (or DUQUESNE_USERNAME / DUQUESNE_PASSWORD for Compose) and restart it.

collector_unreachable.title: Duquesne collector unreachable
collector_unreachable.description: Home Assistant hasn't been able to reach the collector at {url} since {since}. Check that the add-on or container is running, or reconfigure the integration if its address changed.
